# Field Guide

## Creative brief values

Store each value with an origin:

- `provided`: supplied by the project.
- `derived`: supported by upstream evidence.
- `proposed`: a reversible planning suggestion.
- `unknown`: unresolved and unsafe to infer.

## Narrative nodes

A node should represent a production-relevant change, not an arbitrary slice of equal duration. Include:

- purpose
- situation before and after
- active characters
- location
- emotional direction
- source beat IDs
- asset candidates

## Planning board

Treat board dimensions as an option. Preserve narrative order even when some cells remain empty.
